topic: The film rejected by every single studio that went on to make 4 billion dollars
hook: Every studio rejected it. It made 4 billion dollars.
script: Every studio rejected it. It made 4 billion dollars. George Lucas pitched Star Wars to every major studio in Hollywood. All said no. Universal passed. United Artists passed. Disney passed. 20th Century Fox finally agreed — then tried to take his merchandising rights away. Lucas kept them. The film made 775 million. The merchandise made billions more. The studios that said no still haven't recovered from that decision. Follow for Hollywood rejection stories that rewrote industry history.
